description: This header file defines the interface 'IEventHandler' in the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, specifying virtual callback methods for various event types.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: An interface defining callback methods for handling different events related to runtime, window management, ripple, and state changes.

methods.name: onRuntimeManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles runtime manager events, receives an immutable JSON object with event data.

methods.name: onWindowManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles window manager events, receives an immutable JSON object with event data.

methods.name: onRippleEvent
methods.description: Handles ripple events, takes an event name and associated JSON data.

methods.name: onStateChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles state change events, receives an immutable JSON object with event data.
